name: ImageCropper
description:
Crop an image to a fixed shape or freely. With a locked aspect the image moves under a frame
of that shape (drag, pinch, wheel or keys; the slider zooms). With `"free"` a
box with handles sits over the whole image. `onValueChange` reports the crop in source
pixels once per gesture. Pair with `cropToBlob` to make the file, or use `ImageCropDialog`
for picking, checking and saving; the application uploads the result.
signature: ({ src, image: imageProp, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, aspect: aspectProp, defaultAspect, onAspectChange, aspects, shape, minWidth, minHeight, fields, disabled, placeholder, overlay, actionsRef, locale: localeProp, labels, className, }: ImageCropperProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: actionsRef
props.description: Receives the cropper's commands.

props.name: aspect
props.description: Width ÷ height the crop keeps, or `"free"`. Pair with `onAspectChange` to control it.

props.name: aspects
props.description: Shapes to choose between, shown as a segmented control. Without it the aspect stays as given.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only.

props.name: defaultAspect
props.description: The starting aspect when uncontrolled. Default `"free"`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting crop when uncontrolled. Default: the largest crop of the shape, or the whole image.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: fields
props.description: Show number fields for the crop's position and size: the way to place it with one pointer press at a time. Default true.

props.name: image
props.description: The image's pixel size, when known. Read from `src` otherwise.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ cropRole: string; cropLabel: string; cropInstructions: string; freeInstructions: string; zoom: string; aspect: string; free: string; left: string; top: string; width: string; height: string; changeImage: string; chooseImage: string; dropImage: string; chooseImageFirst: string; save: string; saving: string; saved: string; notSaved: string; cancel: string; removeImage: string; removing: string; savingImage: string; saveFailed: string; removeFailed: string; anyImage: string; notSupported: (name: string, formats: string) => string; tooLarge: (name: string, size: string) => string; unreadable: (name: string) => string; tooSmall: (width: string, height: string) => string; maxFileSize: (size: string) => string; minPixels: (width: string, height: string) => string; noImage: string; chosenImage: string; replace: string; crop: string; edit: string; remove: string; addImage: string; imageRequired: string; }> | undefined
props.description: Wording overrides.

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting and wording locale; defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: The smallest crop height in source pixels.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: The smallest crop width in source pixels; a locked crop stops zooming here.

props.name: onAspectChange
props.description: Called with the next aspect when the person picks one of `aspects`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the crop in whole pixels: when an image first shows, and once per gesture when it ends, never during a drag.

props.name: overlay
props.description: Content over the frame, such as a drop hint; the frame takes a dashed outline while it shows.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the frame until there is an image.

props.name: shape
props.description: `round` dims the corners a round picture will not show; the crop is still a rectangle. Default `rect`.

props.name: src
props.description: The image's URL. Without it the frame shows `placeholder`.

props.name: value
props.description: The crop in the image's pixels. Pair with `onValueChange` to control it.
